dataset: Korean dictionary source for Go TOPIK
source: Kaikki.org postprocessed Korean dictionary extracted from the English Wiktionary edition
attribution: Derived from Wiktionary Korean-language entries via Kaikki.org/Wiktextract. Attribute Wiktionary contributors, link the source entry URLs and CC BY-SA 4.0, and indicate that this data was filtered, deduplicated, aggregated, and truncated to 30,000 headwords.
sourceExtractionNote: Kaikki page states this slice was extracted 2026-10-30 from the enwiktionary dump dated 2026-10-01 using Wiktextract.

filtering.headwordScript: Hangul syllables only, with optional Hangul-separated spaces, hyphens, or middle dots
filtering.primaryGlossRequirement: At least one gloss-bearing sense without form-of, alt-of, or alternative tags
filtering.deduplication: One output record per unique Korean headword; source glosses across its qualifying records are joined in source order and capped at 1200 characters
filtering.selection: All catalog-overlap candidates first, then lexical POS and source-gloss richness, with a stable SHA-256 headword tie-breaker; final output sorted by word

limitations: Wiktionary coverage and editorial quality vary; this is not an official national dictionary.
Some inflected, dialectal, archaic, technical, or low-frequency entries remain because they are legitimate sourced entries and the usable pool is only modestly above 30,000.
Proper-name POS entries, Hanja/character entries, pure romanizations, syllables, symbols, punctuation, and glossless/form-only headwords were excluded.
Romanization is included only when present in the source forms; otherwise it is empty.
